definitions.explanation: The progress or advancement of work, projects, or tasks. Commonly used in business and project management contexts.

examples.japanese: プロジェクトの{進捗|しんちょく}{状況|じょうきょう}を{報告|ほうこく}してください。
examples.english: Please report on the project's progress.

examples.japanese: {作業|さぎょう}は{順調|じゅんちょう}に{進捗|しんちょく}している。
{進捗|しんちょく}が{遅|おく}れている。

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{進|すす}む (to advance) + {捗|ちょく} (to make progress)
Note: {捗|ちょく} is rarely used alone and mainly appears in this word.

USAGE AS VERB:
{進捗|しんちょく}する - to progress, to make headway
・{工事|こうじ}が{進捗|しんちょく}する (construction progresses)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{進捗|しんちょく}{状況|じょうきょう} (progress status)
・{進捗|しんちょく}{報告|ほうこく} (progress report)
・{進捗|しんちょく}{管理|かんり} (progress management)
・{進捗|しんちょく}が{遅|おく}れる (progress is delayed)
・{進捗|しんちょく}を{確認|かくにん}する (to check progress)

REGISTER:
Formal/business. Very common in workplace communication.

ALTERNATIVE READING:
Sometimes informally read as しんぽ in casual speech, but しんちょく is the standard reading.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{進行|しんこう} - progression (more general)
・{前進|ぜんしん} - forward movement
・{進展|しんてん} - development, progress
